pages.title: Hyperdimensional Wafer
pages.text: A wafer with more surface than its area allows, because part of it extends into a fourth dimension. Circuits can be laid out on its hidden face as well as the visible one. Running a finger across it, the surface feels longer than it should.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Slicing a Hyperdimensional Boule in the Planck-Scale Cutter, I measured each wafer's surface and found more of it than geometry allows. The extra area lay in a direction my ruler could not point.
Made in $(item)Planck-Scale Cutter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic Logic Wafer, Empirical Notes I, Hyperdimensional Logic Wafer.
